english.title: Unship / unload prohibited weapon / ammunition with intent to evade prohibition / restriction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to evade any prohibition or restriction for the time being in force with respect to the importation into Great Britain of

(A)_[a prohibited weapon]_
(B)_[prohibited weapons]_
(C)_[prohibited ammunition]_
(D)_[a prohibited weapon and ammunition]_
(E)_[prohibited weapons and ammunition]_

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine of the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods, whichever is the greater.
INDICTMENT: Life imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
